I'm assuming you mean a urinary catheter drainage valve. You would not use one, and would leave the catheter on free drainage into a bag, when you need accurate hourly urine output (for example, critically ill or post-operative patients), when the bladder has high pressure or poor compliance or there is a risk of reflux into the kidneys, or when the patient cannot reliably sense bladder fullness or operate the valve.

CONFIDENCE: 60
